name: San Juan River
gaugeName: San Juan River near Bluff, UT
blurb: Sand Island to Mexican Hat (Upper San Juan) and the Goosenecks / Mexican Hat to Clay Hills (Lower San Juan). BLM permit required year-round.

sections.notes: BLM permit required year-round. River rapids are Class II to III. River left (south) is Navajo Nation; separate permission is required for camping and hiking. Follow the current ramp closure above. BLM advises against leaving vehicles overnight at Mexican Hat because of break-ins.

sections.notes: Government Rapid often requires scouting. Clay Hills is the only viable take-out; BLM warns of a dangerous waterfall downstream. Do not miss the take-out. CR 278 can be impassable when wet. Follow the current Mexican Hat launch closure above.
